apps.name: My Assistant
apps.longDescription: My Assistant runs an open-source language model entirely on this phone, once you've downloaded one. Chats, the model file and every setting stay local: no account, no cloud, no server in the loop.

privacy.title: Internet
privacy.text: Only used to {download a model} file you choose, and for the optional {web page on your own Wi-Fi}, which only runs while the app is open. {Chatting never touches the internet}.

privacy.title: Your chats
privacy.text: Chats, settings and downloaded models are saved privately on this phone.

privacy.title: Notifications
privacy.text: Tells you when a model has finished downloading.

privacy.title: Digital assistant
privacy.text: Off until you choose My Assistant as your phone's digital assistant in Android's settings. Then the assistant gesture opens the chat. It reads nothing from the screen and never listens.

privacy.title: Tracking and ads
privacy.text: No analytics, no accounts, no ads.

privacy.title: Cloud backup
privacy.text: Your data is never copied to the cloud, not even by Android's own backup.

apps.name: My Calendar
apps.longDescription: My Calendar shows your days as a year, a month, a week, a day or one long agenda, with events that repeat the way real life does (every other Thursday, the 4th Thursday of the month, every weekday) and several calendars you can switch on and off. Export or import any calendar as a file you own. Everything stays on this phone: no account, no cloud and no internet.

privacy.title: Internet
privacy.text: Never connects to the internet. Everything stays on this phone.

privacy.title: Your events
privacy.text: Saved on this phone only. Nothing is sent to any service or cloud. The only files it touches are the ones you choose to export or import.

privacy.title: Other apps
privacy.text: My Launcher can show what is on your calendar, and add an event from its search, but only after you allow each in Android's own dialog. It cannot change or delete an event, and notes, links and passcodes are never shared. If you switch on the Birthdays calendar, this app reads the birthdays of your contacts from My Connect, the same way: only if you allow it, and only to read.

privacy.title: Tracking and ads
privacy.text: No analytics, no accounts, no ads.

privacy.title: Cloud backup
privacy.text: Your data is never copied to the cloud, not even by Android's own backup. Backups are files you save yourself.

apps.name: My Clock
apps.longDescription: My Clock is a clock, an alarm clock, a timer, a stopwatch and a world clock you can slide through the day: tap New York, slide to 8 am, and see what time it is in India. A running timer or the stopwatch stays in the notification bar with Pause, +1 min and Lap buttons, and as a live pill on Android 16. Everything stays on this phone: no account, no cloud and no internet.
facts: Clock · Alarm · Timer · Stopwatch · World clock

privacy.title: Internet
privacy.text: Never connects to the internet. Everything stays on this phone.

privacy.title: Your alarms and timers
privacy.text: Saved on this phone only. Nothing is sent to any service or cloud.

privacy.title: Other apps
privacy.text: My Launcher can show your world clock, alarms, timers and stopwatch, switch an alarm on or off, make a new alarm from its search, start, pause or reset a timer, and run the stopwatch, but only after you allow each in Android's own dialog. It cannot change or delete an alarm.

privacy.title: Notifications
privacy.text: Rings an alarm or a timer, and keeps a running timer or stopwatch in the notification bar with its controls.

privacy.title: On-time alarms
privacy.text: Alarms and timers ring at the exact time, and are set up again after the phone restarts.

privacy.title: Over the lock screen
privacy.text: A ringing alarm or timer can fill the screen, even when the phone is locked.

privacy.title: Tracking and ads
privacy.text: No analytics, no accounts, no ads.

privacy.title: Cloud backup
privacy.text: Your data is never copied to the cloud, not even by Android's own backup.

apps.name: My Connect
apps.longDescription: My Connect puts your phone, contacts and text messages in one place. Dial with smart suggestions, browse people as a list, a grid or photo cards, read and send texts, block unwanted callers by number, range or pattern, and back everything up as files you own. Everything stays on this phone: no account, no cloud and no internet.

privacy.title: Internet
privacy.text: Never connects to the internet. Your contacts, calls and messages are read from this phone and nothing leaves it.

privacy.title: Contacts
privacy.text: Shows them, and changes them only when you add, edit, merge or delete one, or restore a backup.

privacy.title: Calls
privacy.text: Places a call only when you tap a number. Reads the call log to show it, and edits it only to delete or restore calls.

privacy.title: Messages
privacy.text: Reads your texts to show them, and sends one only when you press send. Writes to the message store only as your messages app.

privacy.title: Your phone and messages app
privacy.text: Optional, and chosen in Android's own settings. As your phone app it shows incoming calls and blocks the numbers you list. As your messages app it receives your texts. All of it stays on this phone.

privacy.title: Other apps
privacy.text: My Launcher can show your missed calls, who has written and how many texts are unread, coming birthdays, your starred contacts and your latest calls, and My Calendar can read your contacts' birthdays, but only after you allow each in Android's own dialog. The text of a message is never shared, and nothing can be changed.

privacy.title: Notifications
privacy.text: Shows incoming and missed calls, and new messages.

privacy.title: On-time reminders
privacy.text: Sends a text at the time you scheduled, and reminds you of a birthday at the time you chose. They are set up again after the phone restarts.

privacy.title: Over the lock screen
privacy.text: An incoming call can fill the screen, even when the phone is locked.

privacy.title: Tracking and ads
privacy.text: No analytics, no accounts, no ads.

privacy.title: Cloud backup
privacy.text: Your data is never copied to the cloud, not even by Android's own backup. Backups are files you save yourself.

apps.name: My Emulator
apps.longDescription: My Emulator plays classic NES, Game Boy and Game Boy Color games from files you own. It keeps your place, saves wherever you like, works with touch, game pads and keyboards (with remappable keys, toggles, turbo and combos) and never needs a connection. Everything stays on this phone: no account, no cloud and no internet. One optional feature, Local network access, lets a browser on your own Wi-Fi play the games with this phone running them.
facts: NES · Game Boy · Game Boy Color

privacy.title: Internet and network
privacy.text: Never connects to the internet. The one network feature is Local network access, off until you turn it on in Settings: then devices on your own Wi-Fi can play your games in a browser, with a code. Everything stays on your own network.

privacy.title: Running in the background
privacy.text: While Local network access is on, the app keeps running with a notification that says so, and keeps the phone's Wi-Fi awake. It stops when you turn it off.

privacy.title: Your game files
privacy.text: Reads only the game files and folders you pick with Android's own picker. It asks for no storage permission and never changes or deletes your files.

privacy.title: Tracking and ads
privacy.text: No analytics, no accounts, no ads.

privacy.title: Cloud backup
privacy.text: Your data is never copied to the cloud, not even by Android's own backup.

apps.name: My Expense
apps.longDescription: My Expense keeps track of what you spend and earn, shows where the money goes with charts, and helps you stay inside your budgets. Everything stays on this phone: no account and no cloud. Switch on local network access to see your dashboard and add payments from a browser on the same Wi-Fi.
facts: Offline, with an optional page for your own Wi-Fi

privacy.title: Internet
privacy.text: Never connects to the internet. The only thing it can do is show your ledger to a browser on your own Wi-Fi, and only while you have switched that on in Settings. Any other device is turned away.

privacy.title: Local network access
privacy.text: While it is on, the app keeps running when the screen is off and shows a notification that says so. A browser has to type a 4-character code, can see your spending and add a payment or an income, and cannot change or delete what is already there. It is off again after a restart.

privacy.title: Your data
privacy.text: Your expenses, budgets and settings are saved on this phone only. The only files it touches are the ones you choose to export or restore.

privacy.title: Other apps
privacy.text: My Launcher can show this month's totals and your latest transactions, and add an expense or an income from its search, but only after you allow each in Android's own dialog. It cannot change or delete what is already there.

privacy.title: Tracking and ads
privacy.text: No analytics, no accounts, no ads.

privacy.title: Cloud backup
privacy.text: Your data is never copied to the cloud, not even by Android's own backup.

apps.name: My File
apps.longDescription: My Files is a file manager for this phone: browse every folder, work in two panes at once, copy and move files, keep the folders you use most in Quick access, star favorites, and find anything by name with wildcards or regular expressions. Everything stays on this phone: no account, no cloud and no internet.

privacy.title: Internet
privacy.text: Never connects to the internet. Nothing you do here leaves the phone.

privacy.title: All your files
privacy.text: It can see and change every file on this phone, because that is what a file manager does. Nothing is ever sent anywhere.

privacy.title: Other apps
privacy.text: My Launcher can show how full your storage is, and the names, folders and sizes of the files you starred, added lately or downloaded, but only after you allow it in Android's own dialog. It never reads inside a file and cannot change or delete anything.

privacy.title: Tracking and ads
privacy.text: No analytics, no accounts, no ads.

privacy.title: Cloud backup
privacy.text: Your data is never copied to the cloud, not even by Android's own backup.

apps.name: My Galary
apps.longDescription: My Galary shows the pictures that are already on your phone by date, looks back at what happened on this day in earlier years, and helps you free space: swipe through old photos, find the biggest ones, and sort them by where they came from. Everything stays on this phone: no account, no cloud and no internet.

privacy.title: Internet
privacy.text: Never connects to the internet. Your photos are read from this phone and nothing leaves it.

privacy.title: Your photos
privacy.text: Reads the photos on this phone to show them, never to send them anywhere. A photo is only removed after you confirm it in Android's own sheet.

privacy.title: Fingerprint, face or screen lock
privacy.text: Only to open the app, when you turn the app lock on, and the Hidden album. Android does the check and only says yes or no: the app never sees your fingerprint or face.

privacy.title: Tracking and ads
privacy.text: No analytics, no accounts, no ads.

privacy.title: Cloud backup
privacy.text: Your data is never copied to the cloud, not even by Android's own backup.

apps.name: My Host
apps.longDescription: My Host serves the websites you keep in folders on your phone. Add a folder with an index.html in it, turn hosting on, and open it from any device on your network in a web browser (HTTPS). Each folder is a site at its own path that you can switch on or off, and the app shows who is looking at them and what they opened. Everything stays on your devices: no account, no cloud.

privacy.title: Network
privacy.text: Only answers devices on your own network, and only while hosting is on. It never connects out to anything.

privacy.title: Your files
privacy.text: Other devices can only read the folders you add. The app reads them and never changes or deletes anything in them. It needs the All files access permission to look inside those folders.

privacy.title: Access code
privacy.text: A browser types a 4-character code before it sees any site, which you can renew or turn off. Every connection is encrypted, and the code is saved in an encrypted form.

privacy.title: Running in the background
privacy.text: Keeps hosting when the screen is off, and shows a notification while it does.

privacy.title: After a restart
privacy.text: Can turn hosting on again after the phone restarts, if you turn that on.

privacy.title: Other apps
privacy.text: My Launcher can show whether hosting is on, its address and port, how many sites are on and how many visitors there are, and turn hosting on or off, but only after you allow each in Android's own dialog. The access code, your folders and the visitors' addresses are never shared.

privacy.title: Tracking and ads
privacy.text: No analytics, no accounts, no ads.

privacy.title: Cloud backup
privacy.text: Your data is never copied to the cloud, not even by Android's own backup.

apps.name: My Launcher
apps.description: A personal home and app launcher
apps.longDescription: My Launcher is a home screen that looks and behaves like the Pixel Launcher: pages of icons, folders and widgets over your wallpaper, a dock, a search pill and an apps list with tabs and a letter bar. On top of that it has My Apps integration (swipe right from the first page) with now playing, reminders, calendar, clock, prayer times, notes, expenses, weather, connect, files, network, server, host and lights from the other My apps, plus an optional floating sidebar with quick settings. Type # in its search to do things: add a note, an expense, a reminder or an event, set an alarm or a timer, switch the network filter, or play an album by name.
facts: My Apps integration · floating sidebar · # search commands · icon packs

privacy.title: Internet
privacy.text: Never connects to the internet: the app has no network permission at all, so Android itself refuses any connection.

privacy.title: Your apps
privacy.text: Reads the list of installed apps through Android's launcher service, and only to show them. The list never leaves the phone.

privacy.title: Notification access
privacy.text: Optional, and given in Android's own settings, not asked here. It is used for the dots on icons and for what is playing. The launcher keeps only which apps have a notification, and what is playing: never their text.

privacy.title: My Apps integration
privacy.text: Reads a little from the other My apps, only after you allow each one in Android's own dialog. It can also do a few things in them when you ask, each with a permission of its own: tick a reminder off, switch an alarm on or off and run a timer or the stopwatch, start or stop the network filter, My Server and My Host, switch your lights (My Matter), and, from the search, add a reminder, an event, a line to a note or an expense, or set an alarm or a timer.

privacy.title: Floating sidebar
privacy.text: Off until you switch it on in Settings. It needs Android's Display over other apps, and shows a quiet notification with a Turn off button while it is on. Brightness and rotation change only after you allow Change system settings, and Do not disturb only after you allow Do not disturb access. It comes back after a restart if it was on.

privacy.title: Lock screen and recent apps
privacy.text: Android gives a launcher no other way to turn the screen off or show recent apps, so a gesture or the sidebar uses an accessibility service that you switch on yourself. It asks for no events and cannot read the screen.

privacy.title: Contacts
privacy.text: Only when you turn on Search contacts, to find a name or number from the search. The list never leaves the phone.

privacy.title: Fingerprint, face or screen lock
privacy.text: Only to open an app you locked. Android does the check and only says yes or no: the launcher never sees your fingerprint or face.

privacy.title: Uninstalling apps
privacy.text: Asks Android to remove an app when you choose Uninstall. Android shows its own question first, and nothing is removed unless you confirm.

privacy.title: Tracking and ads
privacy.text: No analytics, no accounts, no ads.

privacy.title: Cloud backup
privacy.text: Your home screen and settings are never copied to the cloud, not even by Android's own backup.

apps.name: My Matter
apps.description: Control Matter lights and smart plugs.
apps.longDescription: My Matter controls the Matter lights and smart plugs in your home straight over your Wi-Fi. Put them in rooms and drag them into the order you like, dim a light, change its colour or pick a preset, switch a whole room's lights at once, switch a plug on or off, save your own scenes (a group of lights, each with its own colour and brightness), play Aurora or Disco on the lights you choose (it keeps playing when you leave the app), and set automations that turn lights and plugs on at a time or when you touch an NFC tag. Everything stays between your phone and your accessories: no account, no cloud, no hub of ours.

privacy.title: Network
privacy.text: Only talks to the accessories on your own Wi-Fi or Ethernet, using Matter's own messages, and finds them with lookups on the local network. There is no server of ours, and nothing is sent anywhere else.

privacy.title: Your home's key
privacy.text: The key that makes your accessories answer only to you is made on this phone and sealed with Android's Keystore. It never leaves the phone and is not in any backup.

privacy.title: Camera
privacy.text: Only while the QR scanner is open, to read the code on an accessory. No picture is kept.

privacy.title: NFC
privacy.text: Writes the tag of an NFC automation, and starts it when you touch the tag. The tag holds a random number and nothing else.

privacy.title: Running in the background
privacy.text: A timed automation wakes the phone for a few seconds, with a notice, to switch your lights and plugs, and again after a restart. Aurora and Disco keep playing when you leave the app, with a notice that has a Stop button, until you stop them or the time you chose runs out.

privacy.title: My Launcher
privacy.text: If you allow it in Android's own dialogs, My Launcher can see which lights are on, by room and by name, and the names of your scenes, and can switch the lights or start a scene (on its lights only). It never sees an address, and nothing about smart plugs.

privacy.title: Tracking and ads
privacy.text: No analytics, no accounts, no ads.

privacy.title: Cloud backup
privacy.text: Your home is never copied to the cloud, not even by Android's own backup.

apps.name: My Movie
apps.longDescription: My Movie plays the video files that are already on your phone: MP4, MKV, AVI, WebM and more, with subtitles, gestures, picture in picture, a history that remembers where you stopped, and playlists. Everything stays on this phone: no account and no cloud. One optional feature, Local network access, lets a browser on your own Wi-Fi play your library.

privacy.title: Internet and network
privacy.text: Never connects to the internet. The one network feature is Local network access, off until you turn it on in Settings: then devices on your own Wi-Fi can play your library in a browser, with a code. Everything stays on your own network.

privacy.title: Video folders
privacy.text: Only the folders you pick. It cannot see anything else on the phone.

privacy.title: Playing in the background
privacy.text: Can keep the sound playing when you leave the app or the screen is off (you choose in Settings), with playback controls in the notification.

privacy.title: Local network access
privacy.text: While it is on, the app keeps running when the screen is off and shows a notification that says so, with a Turn off button. A browser has to type a 4-character code and can only reach the library the app shows.

privacy.title: Tracking and ads
privacy.text: No analytics, no accounts, no ads.

privacy.title: Cloud backup
privacy.text: Your data is never copied to the cloud, not even by Android's own backup.

apps.name: My Music
apps.longDescription: My Music plays the music files that are already on your phone: songs, albums, artists and folders, a queue you can reorder, playlists, and home screen widgets. Everything stays on this phone: no account, no cloud and no internet.

privacy.title: Internet
privacy.text: Never connects to the internet. Your music is read from this phone and nothing leaves it.

privacy.title: Music folders
privacy.text: Only the folders you pick. It cannot see anything else on the phone.

privacy.title: Playing in the background
privacy.text: Keeps music playing when the app is closed or the screen is off, with playback controls in the notification.

privacy.title: Other apps
privacy.text: My Launcher can show the albums of your library (title, artist, year, number of songs and cover), but only after you allow it in Android's own dialog. No file name, folder or song title is shared, and nothing can be changed.

privacy.title: Tracking and ads
privacy.text: No analytics, no accounts, no ads.

privacy.title: Cloud backup
privacy.text: Your data is never copied to the cloud, not even by Android's own backup.

apps.name: My Network
apps.longDescription: My Network blocks ads and trackers on this phone by refusing the name lookups that belong to them, and shows you which sites your apps talk to. It works as a local VPN: nothing is sent to a server of ours, and your pages, videos and messages travel the way they always did. Blocklists are yours to choose, import and export.

privacy.title: Internet
privacy.text: Used to pass the names that are let through on to the DNS server you chose, and to download a blocklist when you add or update one. There is no server of ours, and your log is never sent anywhere.

privacy.title: VPN connection
privacy.text: A local one: the app only takes the DNS lookups of your apps, on this phone, and answers them itself or passes them to the DNS server you chose. No traffic goes through any server of ours.

privacy.title: The log
privacy.text: The names your apps looked up are kept in a small database on this phone, for the dashboard. Switch it off, set how long it is kept, or clear it in Settings.

privacy.title: Apps on this phone
privacy.text: Reads the names of installed apps to say which one made a lookup, and to let you leave some out. The list never leaves the phone.

privacy.title: Other apps
privacy.text: My Launcher can show whether the filter is on and how many names were looked up and blocked today, and start, stop, pause or resume it, but only after you allow each in Android's own dialog. Not one name, site or app is shared.

privacy.title: Notifications
privacy.text: While the filter runs, shows that protection is on, with buttons to pause it or turn it off.

privacy.title: After a restart
privacy.text: Can turn the filter on again after the phone restarts, if you turn that on.

privacy.title: Tracking and ads
privacy.text: No analytics, no accounts, no ads.

privacy.title: Cloud backup
privacy.text: Your data is never copied to the cloud, not even by Android's own backup. Backups are files you save yourself.

apps.name: My Note
apps.longDescription: My Note keeps your quick notes on this phone, in the same calm look as the rest of the family. Switch on remote access to read and edit them from a browser on the same Wi-Fi. No account and no ads.

privacy.title: Internet
privacy.text: Only used while remote access is on, to share your notes page with a computer on your own Wi-Fi. Nothing goes out over the internet.

privacy.title: Your notes
privacy.text: Saved on this phone only. Nothing is sent to any service or cloud.

privacy.title: Other apps
privacy.text: My Launcher can show the headings of your latest notes, and add a line to a note from its search, but only after you allow each in Android's own dialog. Locked notes are never shown or touched, and nothing can be changed or deleted this way.

privacy.title: Remote access
privacy.text: While remote access is on, the app keeps running when the screen is off and shows a notification that says so.

privacy.title: Fingerprint and face
privacy.text: Only to open notes you lock. Android does the check and only tells the app yes or no: the app never sees your fingerprint or face.

privacy.title: Tracking and ads
privacy.text: No analytics, no accounts, no ads.

privacy.title: Cloud backup
privacy.text: Your data is never copied to the cloud, not even by Android's own backup.

apps.longDescription: My Prayer works out the daily prayer times for where you are, counts down to the next one and reminds you when it begins. Everything is calculated on this phone: no account, no cloud and no internet.

privacy.title: Internet
privacy.text: Never connects to the internet. Prayer times are worked out on this phone.

privacy.title: Location
privacy.text: Your approximate position, only when you tap Use my location. It never leaves the phone.

privacy.title: Notifications
privacy.text: Tells you when a prayer time begins.

privacy.title: On-time reminders

privacy.title: Other apps

privacy.title: Tracking and ads
privacy.text: No analytics, no accounts, no ads.

privacy.title: Cloud backup
privacy.text: Your data is never copied to the cloud, not even by Android's own backup.

apps.name: My Reminder
apps.longDescription: My Reminder keeps the things you don't want to forget, and nudges you when they are due, in the same calm look as the rest of the family. Everything stays on this phone. No account and no ads.

privacy.text: Never connects to the internet. Everything stays on this phone.

privacy.title: Your reminders
privacy.text: Saved on this phone only. Nothing is sent to any service or cloud.

privacy.title: Other apps
privacy.text: My Launcher can show your upcoming reminders, and, from its search, add a reminder or tick one off, but only after you allow each in Android's own dialog. It cannot change or delete a reminder.

privacy.title: Notifications
privacy.text: Shows a reminder when it is due.

privacy.title: On-time alarms
privacy.text: Reminders ring at the exact minute, and are set up again after the phone restarts.

privacy.title: Over the lock screen
privacy.text: Important reminders can fill the screen, even when the phone is locked.

privacy.text: No analytics, no accounts, no ads.

privacy.text: Your data is never copied to the cloud, not even by Android's own backup.

apps.name: My Secret
apps.longDescription: My Secret keeps your passwords, one-time codes and payment cards in one encrypted vault that opens with a single master password. Everything stays on this phone: no account, no cloud and no internet.

privacy.title: Internet
privacy.text: Never connects to the internet. Everything stays on this phone.

privacy.title: Files you pick
privacy.text: Only the files you choose to back up, restore or import. It cannot see any other file.

privacy.title: Encryption
privacy.text: Your vault is locked with a key made from your master password. The password itself is never saved.

privacy.title: Fingerprint or face
privacy.text: Optional. Lets you unlock with your fingerprint or face. The scan stays in the phone's own secure area; this app never sees it.

privacy.title: Camera
privacy.text: Optional and off until you allow it. Only for scanning a one-time-code QR code; nothing is recorded or saved. Or type the secret instead.

privacy.title: Autofill
privacy.text: Off until you choose it in Android's settings. Then Android shows this app the login form on screen so it can fill it, after you unlock the vault. Nothing leaves the phone.

privacy.title: Tracking and ads
privacy.text: No analytics, no accounts, no ads.

privacy.title: Cloud backup
privacy.text: Your data is never copied to the cloud, not even by Android's own backup.

apps.name: My Server
apps.longDescription: My Server shares folders on your phone over SFTP or in a web browser (HTTPS) so you can move files to and from any computer on your network with the tools you already use. Everything stays on your devices: no account, no cloud.

privacy.title: Network
privacy.text: Only takes connections while the server runs. It never connects out to anything.

privacy.title: Your files
privacy.text: Other devices can only reach the folder you share, and only while the server runs. The app needs to be able to read and change files in that folder.

privacy.title: Encryption
privacy.text: Every connection is encrypted, and the password is saved in an encrypted form.

privacy.title: Running in the background
privacy.text: Keeps the server running when the screen is off, and shows a notification while it does.

privacy.title: After a restart
privacy.text: Can start the server again after the phone restarts, if you turn that on.

privacy.title: Other apps
privacy.text: My Launcher can show whether the server is running, for how long, where to reach it, how many devices are connected and how much has moved, and start or stop it, but only after you allow each in Android's own dialog. No user name, password, key or folder is ever shared.

privacy.title: Tracking and ads
privacy.text: No analytics, no accounts, no ads.

privacy.title: Cloud backup
privacy.text: Your data is never copied to the cloud, not even by Android's own backup.

apps.name: My Weather
apps.longDescription: My Weather shows the weather where you are now, the next 24 hours and the week ahead, in the same calm look as the rest of the family. No account and no ads. Forecasts come from Open-Meteo, a free weather service.

privacy.title: Internet
privacy.text: Only used to get the forecast and to search for places, from Open-Meteo. Nothing else uses the internet.

privacy.title: Your places
privacy.text: The places you pick are saved on this phone. Only a place's position is sent to Open-Meteo, to get its forecast.

privacy.title: Your location
privacy.text: Your approximate position, only when you tap Use my location.

privacy.title: Other apps

privacy.text: No analytics, no accounts, no ads.
